basic_info.description: This distinguished light filled 1924 classic home blends traditional details with modern amenities. The elegant formal living room is perfect for relaxed entertaining featuring a marble fireplace, cathedral ceilings & oversized arched framed windows. The formal dining room provides an ideal setting for hosting dinner parties & family gatherings.  The gourmet kitchen outfitted with high-end appliances including a Viking stove is complemented by a built-in eating table with built-in benches, an ideal space for casual meals.   The upper level floor hosts three generous bedrooms alongside a well-appointed bathroom featuring a separate bath tub & shower. There is also a closet containing the washer/dryer on this level. Hardwood floors throughout the main and upper levels.  The lower level is designed for relaxation & versatility with a spacious family room, an additional bedroom, a full bathroom & an abundance of storage. There is a one car garage with interior access in addition to parking for three cars in the driveway.  Outside, the property features a unique tiered yard showcasing a labyrinth grass pattern, adding an artistic & functional outdoor element. This residence is perfect for those seeking exceptional design, quality craftsmanship, & a modern lifestyle.
